intro.title: Good massage starts with listening.
body: Before your massage, June asks which areas you want to focus on and what pressure feels comfortable. She combines Thai and modern techniques, adjusting the session to your feedback.
Choose from nine treatments, from gentle massage with aromatic oils to focused work on specific areas. If you are unsure where to start, June will help you choose.

about: Born in Thailand, June grew up close to experienced massage practitioners. That early connection to touch and movement continues to shape her work.

In 2023 she won silver in Freestyle Eastern at the Swiss Massage Championship in Zurich, and silver in Wellness & Spa at the World Massage Federation competition in Athens. Penzberg brought three further medals, including bronze in Champ of the Champs, where category champions competed for the overall ranking.
At LUMA Wellness, June takes time to understand what you need. She discusses your preferences before the massage and adjusts the pressure and techniques as you go.

aroma-luxus.name: LUMA Aroma-Luxus Massage
aroma-luxus.description: Flowing massage with aromatic oils made from organic jojoba. A gentle, unhurried session for anyone who enjoys fragrance and time to relax.
details: Flowing, rhythmic movements combine with organic jojoba aroma oils. Before starting, June discusses the areas you would like her to focus on and your preferred pressure.
Please mention any sensitivity to oils or fragrances when arranging your visit.

balance-stone.name: Balance Stone & Bamboo Massage
balance-stone.description: Shaped granite Balance Stones and bamboo tools bring warmth and varied pressure to the massage. June adjusts the session to your preferences and the areas you want to focus on.
details: Specially shaped granite stones and bamboo tools allow broad strokes as well as more focused work. Their different surfaces give the massage its distinctive feel.
June agrees the warmth and pressure with you. Let her know whenever you would prefer a lighter touch or less heat.

thai-solution.name: LUMA Thai Solution Massage
thai-solution.description: Nuad Benja Phaki combines Thai-inspired stretches, focused pressure, and bodywork without oil. June offers light, medium, or deeper pressure to suit your preferences.
details: Nuad Benja Phaki brings Thai stretching techniques and focused pressure together in an oil-free session.
Choose light, medium or deeper pressure. June adjusts the stretches and intensity to your feedback throughout the massage.

schwangerschaft.name: LUMA Pregnancy Massage
schwangerschaft.description: A gentle massage with the comfort of expectant mothers in mind. Talk to June before booking about your pregnancy and what you need from the session.
details: Gentle techniques and a comfortable position are central to this treatment for expectant mothers. Discuss your pregnancy and preferences with June before booking.
If you have symptoms or health concerns, check with your maternity care professional whether massage is appropriate for you.

gold-medalie.name: LUMA Gold Medalie Signature
gold-medalie.description: June’s signature massage combines Balance Stones, classic massage, cupping and aromatherapy. A specially created soundscape accompanies techniques recognised at international competitions.
details: This massage draws on the techniques that earned June gold in Wellness & Spa at the Universal Massage Championship in Penzberg in 2023. It combines Balance Stones, classic massage, cupping and aromatherapy.
A soundscape created for the session accompanies the massage. June explains the techniques and agrees the approach with you beforehand.
Cupping can leave visible marks. Please discuss pregnancy, blood-thinning medication or other health concerns before booking, and seek medical advice if you are unsure about suitability.

stark-ball.name: Stark Ball Massage
stark-ball.description: A method developed by world champion Nadine Stark Chognon. June uses specially shaped massage balls to work on individual muscle groups.
details: Developed by Nadine Stark Chognon, this method uses specially shaped massage balls to work on individual muscle groups.
June controls the placement and pressure of the tools, adapting the session to your feedback. Ask her about the technique if you would like to know how it differs from hands-only massage.

gesicht-kopf.name: Face & Head Massage with Gua Sha
gesicht-kopf.description: Gentle massage for the face and head, combined with a Gua Sha tool. The session is dedicated to these areas.
details: The session focuses on the face and head, combining gentle hands-on massage with a Gua Sha tool.
Please mention skin conditions, injuries or ongoing medical treatments before booking so that suitability can be discussed with your care professional when needed.

schulter-nacken-ruecken.name: Shoulder, Neck & Back Massage
schulter-nacken-ruecken.description: Focused attention for areas that often feel tense in everyday life. June tailors the massage to your shoulders, neck, and back, with pressure agreed together.
details: A focused session for the shoulders, neck and back. Before starting, June asks which areas you would like her to concentrate on.
Pressure is agreed together and can be adjusted at any time. The 30-minute and 60-minute options let you choose how much time to devote to these areas.

fuss.name: LUMA Foot Massage
fuss.description: Focused pressure and massage for tired feet, especially welcome after a long day spent standing or walking.
details: Massage strokes and focused pressure give the feet particular attention after time spent standing or walking.
Let June know about any sensitive areas before the session. Pressure is adjusted together, with 30-minute and 60-minute options available.

faq: What makes LUMA Wellness special?
June combines Thai-inspired techniques with contemporary approaches and the experience of international massage competitions. Every guest receives personal attention in her Buxtehude studio.
Which treatment should I choose?

The nine treatments offer different approaches. Aroma-Luxus uses aromatic oils, while Thai Solution combines stretches and pressure without oil. Gold Medalie Signature brings several techniques together. June can help if you are unsure which to choose.
What is Thai Solution Massage?
An oil-free massage combining Thai stretches and focused pressure. June adjusts the intensity to your preferences.
What should I expect at my first visit?
June explains the session and asks what you would like from your massage. Mention any health concerns or sensitivities before starting. You can ask to change the pressure or movements at any time.
Are there treatments for particular needs?
The range includes pregnancy massage and focused work for the shoulders, neck, back, and feet. Contact June to discuss which option may suit your circumstances.
How do Aroma-Luxus and Gold Medalie differ?
Aroma-Luxus combines classic massage with organic jojoba aroma oils. Gold Medalie brings together several techniques, including Balance Stones and cupping, with a soundscape created for the session.
How do I arrange an appointment?
Use the enquiry form to prepare a WhatsApp or email message, or call June directly. Booking a few days ahead is helpful. Your time is confirmed personally by June.
What about hygiene?
June uses fresh linen and towels, cleans the tools and takes care with hand hygiene. The studio is kept clean and ventilated. Speak with her if you have any questions.
Can I buy a gift voucher?
Contact June for the gift vouchers, packages and offers currently available.
Where is the studio?
LUMA Wellness is inside HAUTNAH at Hauptstraße 19, 21614 Buxtehude. Visits are by appointment only. You can plan your journey with Google Maps or Apple Maps on the Contact page.
Where can I read the cancellation policy?
The terms, including the cancellation policy, are available in German through the Terms link at the bottom of the page. Ask June for an explanation if you need one before confirming your appointment.
